metaDescription: Search, optimize and track job applications in one place.
scoutDescription: Ask Scout to find open roles. Try a role, a place, or remote work.
scoutNoJobs: No live matches found for that search. Try a broader role or location.
scoutComposerPlaceholder: Search for a role, location, or remote work
chatErrorGeneric: The request could not be completed. Try again shortly.
scoutGreeting: Hello, {name}. What role are you scouting for today?
optimizeDescription: Targeting questions and a resume artifact will appear here.
optimizeValueHeadline: Land more interviews with an ATS-ready resume
optimizeValueEvidence: Every suggestion stays grounded in what your resume already says
optimizeValueApprove: You approve every change. No invented experience.
optimizeValueHighlight: Highlight your most relevant skills and experience
optimizeAddSubtitle: Select your most recent resume or upload a new one.
optimizeNoResume: Upload a resume to start an optimize session.
optimizeDisclaimer: This feature is in beta. Resume optimizer uses generative AI to provide resume guidance. Please review all suggestions to ensure they accurately reflect your experience and skills.
optimizeSessionMissingDescription: Upload a resume before starting an optimize session.
optimizeSessionMissingAlert: This session needs a resume in working memory.
optimizeSeedMessage: Please start my Optimize session: call analyze-resume, give a Quick Audit critique (no rewrite yet), then ask targeting questions with clarify (role, then industry). After I answer or skip both, call rewrite-resume for an evidence-only targeted draft.
jobsDescription: Roles you save from scout will show up in this split view.
profileDescription: Your working profile starts here. Drop a PDF, DOCX or TXT and Scout and Optimize build on what the document actually says.
profileUploadPlaceholder: Drop a PDF, DOCX or TXT file, or click to browse
profileUploadHelper: The source text is kept for evidence-based rewrites.
profileErrorUnsupportedFormat: This file type is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX or TXT.
profileErrorFileTooLarge: The file is larger than 8 MB. Try a smaller resume.
profileErrorUnreadable: This file could not be read as text. It may be corrupt or password protected.
profileErrorUpload: Something went wrong while uploading. Try again.
profileUpdateDescription: Replace the stored file with a new upload.
profileFieldsNote: These facts are extracted from your resume. Unreadable fields stay empty and experience is never invented.
